item.title: Hungarian railway company MÁV launches new 15% ‘smart discount’ – but scraps earlier, more generous fare cut
item.description: MÁV has launched a new 15% digital “smart discount” after it quietly scrapped a previous advance-purchase discount of up to 40%.

item.title: Great! High-speed railway to Budapest Airport gets greenlight by Hungary’s government
item.description: Hungary’s government has confirmed plans to advance the long-awaited dedicated airport rail link to Budapest Airport.

item.title: Embassy of Colombia in Hungary hosts cultural diplomacy dinner highlighting the flavours of the Pacific – photos
item.description: A diplomatic dinner in Budapest spotlighted Colombia’s Pacific culinary heritage, featuring Chef Vanessa Lourido and a menu rich in history, identity and tradition. #colombia #embajadadecolombia #gastronomy #diplomacy

item.title: The US wants to tear the European Union apart, with Hungary involved
item.description: The United States government released a 33-page strategy, which claims Europe is having a “civilisational decline”, and they need Hungary as one of the few chosen partners.

item.title: Most Hungarians fear foreign intervention in next year’s parliamentary elections
item.description: More than half consider Russia the most likely actor to interfere with Hungary's parliamential elections in 2026.

item.title: Director of the Szőlő Street juvenile detention centre under arrest
item.description: Hungarian prosecutors have ordered the arrest of the former acting director of the Szőlő Street juvenile correctional institute in Budapest.

item.title: Planning on moving? Hungary’s rental prices fall for a third month as demand weakens
item.description: Budapest rents keep dropping as demand weakens and supply grows. Find out what this means for tenants for the last month of 2025!

item.title: Growing interest in Hungary’s Home Start Program thanks to flexible conditions
item.description: Home Start Program can now open the path to home ownership even for those who previously did not meet the strict eligibility requirements.

item.title: The United States wants to make Donbas a “free economic zone” as part of a new peace deal
item.description: The United States has proposed a new compromise aimed at reviving stalled peace efforts between Ukraine and Russia — a plan that would see Ukrainian troops pull back from parts of the Donbas, while Moscow’s forces would be barred from entering the vacated territory.
